alt: Back of the OPPO Find X10 Pro Max showing a wide horizontal camera island spanning the full width of the phone with three large identical 200MP camera circles in a row, plus the Hasselblad branding
story: OPPO's leaked Find X10 Pro Max (Aug 28, 2026) features three separate 200-megapixel cameras — wide, ultrawide, and telephoto — which OPPO is marketing as a '600 MP Hasselblad camera system,' a number reached by simply adding three identical specs together.
why_funny: Adding three of the same absurd spec to get a bigger absurd spec is phone-design arithmetic at its finest — next year's model will presumably have four 200MP cameras and be called '800MP.'
